description: The figure presents three pie charts comparing the distribution of four CoT categories across difficulty levels (“easy,” “medium,” and “hard”), with 4 slices in each chart and a shared legend on the right. In the easy chart, the slices are labeled N+K+ (teal) at 40.6%, N−K+ (yellow) at 45.9%, N−K− (light orange) at 10.1%, and N+K− (red) at 3.3%, with percentage labels shown inside the slices. In the medium chart, N+K+ (teal) is 44.6%, N−K+ (yellow) is 44.3%, N−K− (light orange) is 7.2%, and N+K− (red) is 3.9%, again with percentages printed within slices. In the hard chart, N−K+ (yellow) is 36.2%, N+K+ (teal) is 20.1%, and N+K− (red) is 7.0%, while the N−K− (light orange) slice is present but its percentage label is not visible due to a gray rectangular overlay covering part of that slice; no slices appear exploded or offset, and the slice ordering varies by chart rather than following a consistent descending-size arrangement.
